title: Schedule of Deposit Shares and Payment Periods, Resort Lodging
content:
The figures the finance office publishes for each Resort Lodging unit type on the money taken before arrival are the deposit share, the deposit period, the balance period and whether the deposit is refundable.

The deposit share is the percentage of the room rate for the whole stay taken as a deposit when the reservation is made. The deposit period is the number of calendar days after the hold is placed within which the deposit must clear. The balance period is the number of calendar days before arrival by which the rest of the room rate falls due. The refundable column records whether the deposit comes back when a cancellation falls inside the free cancellation period.

| Unit type | Deposit share of the room rate | Deposit period (calendar days) | Balance period before arrival (calendar days) | Deposit refundable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 25 percent | 3 | 7 | yes |
| Slopeside Studio | 25 percent | 3 | 14 | yes |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 30 percent | 3 | 14 | yes |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 30 percent | 5 | 21 | yes |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 35 percent | 5 | 21 | yes |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 50 percent | 7 | 30 | no |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 50 percent | 7 | 45 | no |

### Points of judgement on the figures

The deposit share and the deposit period are separate figures and move independently: the Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence carries a higher deposit share than the Slopeside Studio, 30 percent against 25 percent, on the same deposit period of 3 calendar days. The two unit types whose deposit is not refundable, the Summit Penthouse Residence and the Private Mountain Chalet, are also the two carrying the longest balance periods, 30 and 45 calendar days before arrival.
